mapper.update: update img_search_sync_task set status = 1, start_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{taskId} and status in (0, 3)
update img_search_sync_task set status = 2, request_id = #{requestId}, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{taskId}

update img_search_sync_task set status = 3, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{taskId}
update img_search_sync_task set status = 4, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{taskId}
update img_search_sync_task set status = 5, error_msg = #{reason}, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select * from img_search_sync_task where status = 3 and next_retry_time is not null and next_retry_time <= #{now} order by next_retry_time asc, id asc limit #{limitSize}
